title: Warm Spicy Filipino Pork Wrap
description: A comforting and flavorful Filipino dish featuring spicy pork and crispy ssam wrap, perfect for a sick day or a quick snack
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine onion, garlic, fish sauce, lime juice, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper, and blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the blended mixture and pork shoulder, and mix until the pork is well coated.
Wrap the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to marinate.
Remove the pork from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the pork in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the pork is cooking, warm the ssam wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Slice the cooked pork into thin strips and assemble the wrap by placing the pork onto the warmed ssam wrap.
